changelog: Fixed the 'Channels' button actually rendering as a solid blue bar instead of the intended dark/accent-text look — this app's Material theme auto-upgrades plain buttons to MaterialButton, which ignores a plain background color and paints its own colorPrimary tint over the whole button instead; now pinned to the intended gray via backgroundTint. Also: AMOLED Black now actually reaches the whole app instead of just the outermost screen background — it previously left nearly every card/panel/sidebar showing its own dark-gray color on top, since those are painted separately; enabling it now flattens all of that chrome to pure black too.
